ara: CI red on integration shard 7 against Hosted API — failing tests/integration/test_toolcall_streaming_auth.py::test_toolcall_schema_contract. Started ~08:05 UTC. Anyone else seeing a spike?

michael: Link to job: https://ci.redwood.internal/job/1728500000/shard7 — logs show schema validation error.

ara: failing snippet from the harness:```json
{"error": "JSONSchemaError", "message": "Additional properties are not allowed (\"timeout\" was unexpected)", "payload": {"tool_result": {"name":"search","output":"ok"}, "timeout": 5000}}
```

ci-bot: Build 1728500000 (shard 7) failed — exit code 1. Rerun available: `/ci rerun --shard=7`

sara: we merged #4823 yesterday that tightened the tool-call schema. possibility that runtime added an extra field (timeout/timeout_ms) in streaming path. cc @michael @jen

michael: I can bisect but need a rerun to confirm if it's flaky. Can someone kick a rerun with the same shard+env? e.g. `./scripts/ci/rerun.sh --shard=7 --env=staging` or `/ci rerun --shard=7 --commit-range origin/main~5..origin/main`

jen: I suspect the streaming handshake path attaches `timeout_ms` to the tool payload. Repro locally with:```bash
curl -X POST https://hosted-api/api/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"messages":[{"role":"tool","name":"search","content":{"q":"x","timeout_ms":200}}]}'
``` If schema validator rejects additional props it's our change or the RT runtime adding field.

ara: I'm going to queue a rerun for the failing shard now, and add the failing payload to the ticket. @ci-bot please queue rerun for shard 7.

ci-bot: Rerun queued: job 1728500010 for shard 7 (requested by ara).

michael: Thanks. If rerun passes, we'll roll the schema back in tests or add compatibility. If it remains red, I'll start a bisect across the last 6 commits.

sara: I'll take first pass on diff review for #4823 and confirm whether the stricter validator change is intended. Assigning to me for now. :thumbsup:

jen: FYI I added a quick test snippet to simulate runtime adding `timeout_ms` — pushing to my fork now. If needed I can open a hotfix to acceptance harness to accept both `timeout` and `timeout_ms`.

ara: OK tracking here. Marking P0 for CI unblock. Will update when rerun finishes.
